description: Process manager for Node.js — start, zero-downtime restart, logs, cluster and boot.

pm2-start.title: Start application
pm2-start.description: Starts a PM2-managed process with a friendly name.
examples: Starts an npm script, passing arguments after '--'.
arguments: Number of instances (cluster); 'max' uses all cores.

pm2-ecosystem.title: Start via ecosystem
pm2-ecosystem.description: Starts processes from a declarative configuration file (recommended).

pm2-list.title: List processes
pm2-list.description: Shows the process table: id, name, status, CPU, memory and restarts.

pm2-monit.title: Real-time monitor
pm2-monit.description: Interactive dashboard (btop-style) with CPU, memory and per-process logs.

pm2-describe.title: Process details
pm2-describe.description: Shows detailed information about a process: path, env, uptime, restarts.

pm2-logs.title: View logs
pm2-logs.description: Streams a process's logs (stdout/stderr) in real time.
examples: Shows the last 200 lines before following.

pm2-flush.title: Clear logs
pm2-flush.description: Empties the log files of all processes.
warnings: Removes the log history persisted by PM2.

pm2-reload.title: Zero-downtime reload
pm2-reload.description: Reloads cluster processes one after another, without taking the service down (zero-downtime).
warnings: In fork mode (1 instance) reload is equivalent to a restart with brief unavailability.

pm2-restart.title: Restart
pm2-restart.description: Restarts the process (kills and starts it again). Use 'all' for every process.
warnings: There is a brief unavailability; prefer 'reload' in cluster mode.

pm2-stop.title: Stop
pm2-stop.description: Stops the process while keeping it in the list (status stopped).

pm2-delete.title: Remove from list
pm2-delete.description: Stops and removes the process from PM2's list.
warnings: Removes the process from management; run 'save' afterwards to persist the new state.

pm2-delete-all.title: Remove all
pm2-delete-all.description: Stops and removes ALL processes managed by PM2.
warnings: Takes down all services at once; confirm the target before running in production.

pm2-scale.title: Scale instances
pm2-scale.description: Adjusts the number of instances of a cluster app to the given value.
examples: Adds 2 instances to the existing ones.

pm2-startup.title: Start on boot
pm2-startup.description: Generates and installs the system startup script so PM2 starts on boot.
warnings: The command prints a line with sudo that must be run to complete the installation.

pm2-save.title: Save process list
pm2-save.description: Persists the current process list so it can be restored on boot.

pm2-resurrect.title: Restore processes
pm2-resurrect.description: Reloads the processes previously saved with 'pm2 save'.

pm2-kill.title: Kill the daemon
pm2-kill.description: Kills the PM2 daemon and all the processes it manages.
warnings: Takes everything down, including the daemon itself. Use only for a full reset.
